题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干："The jury is still out" means ______.
A. no decision has been made yet
B. the jury went home
C. everyone agrees
D. the trial is over
考点：短语
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：A jury is made up of ______.
A. judges
B. police officers
C. lawyers
D. ordinary citizens
考点：用法
题目.答案:
【1】C（陪审团）
讲解：jury 陪审团。
【2】B（jury）
讲解：on the jury 在陪审团里。
【3】judge
讲解：法官是 judge；jury 是认定事实的普通公民。
【4】juries
讲解：different 后面接复数，y 变 i 加 es。
【5】jurys → juries
讲解：辅音字母 + y 结尾，复数 y 变 i 加 es。
【6】A（no decision has been made yet）
讲解：the jury is still out 尚无定论。
【7】D（ordinary citizens）
讲解：陪审团由普通公民组成。
